---
name: Handbook Change Proposal (MAJOR)
about: Propose a significant methodological, structural or governance change to the handbook.
title: "[MAJOR]"
labels: ''
assignees: ''

---

**Summary**

Provide a concise summary of the proposed change.

**Type of Major Change**

Select all that apply:

- [ ] New chapter
- [ ] Major restructure of existing content
- [ ] New methodology or approach
- [ ] Significant revision to existing guidance
- [ ] Change to recommendations or best practice
- [ ] New governance process
- [ ] New handbook scope or topic area
- [ ] Other major change

**Background**

Describe the current situation and why a change is being proposed.

**Proposed Change**

Provide a detailed description of the proposal.

Where possible, include:
- Scope of the change
- Draft content or outline
- Relevant examples
- Dependencies on other chapters or resources

**Rationale**

Why is this change needed?

- What problem does it address?
- What evidence supports the change?
- What benefits are expected?

**Affected Chapters**

List the chapters, sections, annexes, notebooks or training materials that may be affected.

**Impact on Existing Guidance**

Describe whether the proposal:

- [ ] Introduces new guidance
- [ ] Alters existing recommendations
- [ ] Changes methodological advice
- [ ] Requires revision of existing examples
- [ ] Requires updates to training materials
- [ ] Requires updates to notebooks or code examples

**Supporting Evidence**

Provide links to relevant publications, papers, country experiences, code repositories, workshops, consultations or other supporting material.

**Contribution Approach**

How would you like this proposal to be taken forward?

- [ ] I intend to develop a draft and submit a pull request
- [ ] I am seeking collaborators to help develop this proposal
- [ ] I would like the Secretariat to coordinate development of this proposal
- [ ] This proposal is being raised for discussion before further work is undertaken

**Additional Comments**

Provide any additional information that may assist the review process.
